name: Kawakami
text: Kawakami (川上村, Kawakami-mura) is a village located in Yoshino District, Nara Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 January 2025, the village had an estimated population of 1,023 and a population density of 3.8 persons per km2. The total area of the village is 269.26 km2 (103.96 sq mi).

depictions.name: Kawakami
depictions.text: Kawakami, Nara Kawakami is a village located in southeastern Yamato, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke traveled through the village while visiting Yamato.
